description: This file defines the Fraud controller for the admin extension of an OpenCart project. It manages listing, installation, and uninstallation of fraud extension modules within the admin interface.

classes.name: Fraud
classes.description: Controller class for managing fraud detection extensions in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Outputs the list view of fraud extensions.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and displays the list of available and installed fraud extensions.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation process of a fraud extension, including permission checks and setup.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles the removal of a fraud extension, including permission checks and cleanup.
